labkit.ui.version

Return the LabKit UI facade contract version.

Syntax

info = labkit.ui.version()

Inputs

None.

Outputs

info
plain struct describing the current labkit.ui contract, the compatible contract ranges implemented by this code, contract status, and a short maintainer note.
